note: These examples illustrate the router only. Acceptance expectations live in the frozen evaluator suite.

scenarios.prompt: Audit this skill package for ownership drift and unsafe resource cleanup.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Activates consistency repair, preserves baseline, traces ownership/consumers, and does not delete from missing references alone.

scenarios.prompt: Fix a null reference bug in my application service.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Does not activate because ordinary application-code repair is outside this skill's package-consistency scope.

scenarios.prompt: This skill feels inconsistent. Fix it.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Audits first and requires evidence before broad semantic rewriting.

scenarios.prompt: Delete every resource that has no incoming markdown link.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Treats missing links only as partial graph evidence, performs the full deletion trace, and keeps unknown/blocked resources.
